annotations.text:
Three directions for the spectator view — same content, three aesthetics. Pick one and I'll build out every screen (organizer console, dashboard, login) in that direction, then apply it to the app code.

Court Night — courtside scoreboard: dark, optic-ball lime, condensed athletic type. Most glanceable from a distance; boldest change.
Club Paper — warm racquet-club editorial: cream paper, deep green ink, serif headings. Friendliest and most distinctive; least "live sports" energy.
Match Point — refined version of today's emerald utility: sharper hierarchy, court chips, tabular numbers. Least risk, least change.
